overview.title: Let's start without spoilers
paragraphs: You wake up in a world with dinosaurs, strange technology, and traces of those who came before. Think of survival as the first chapter of a long mystery: what is this place, who created it, and why are you here?
ARK does not force you to complete the story to build a house, raise animals or play with friends. However, caves, artifacts, bosses and ascensions form a very clear long-term goal.

overview.title: Play to improve what?
paragraphs: The gameplay goes from food and shelter → tools and resources → taming specialized animals → breeding, saddle and equipment → exploring caves → bosses. Each step turns a once insurmountable danger into a prepareable route.
Don't just increase the number of animals. Build a system: transport animals, mining, dungeons, boss teams, food and replacement items. Failure should help you know what is missing for the next trip.

overview.title: Read stories while playing
paragraphs: Explorer Notes is an insider's account; dossiers often explain creatures. A character may misunderstand or hide something, so compare multiple notes with the ending scene.
The Chapter section below has full SPOILERS: the nature of ARK, the fate of the characters and the ending of Genesis. Stop here if you want to explore for yourself.

overview.title: Order of reading the plot
paragraphs: Original Survival Evolved story line: The Island → Scorched Earth → Aberration → Extinction → Genesis Part 1 → Genesis Part 2. The characters in the notes often have experienced these places before the Survivor you control.

Lost Colony is a new chapter of ASA, expanding Arat Prime and connecting to ARK 2. Should be read after understanding Extinction and Genesis; The flashbacks and campaign moments do not form a simple linear sequence between the two original DLCs.

overview.title: Actual ASA playing order
paragraphs: Suggested mechanics-learning order: The Island → Scorched Earth → Aberration → Extinction. Then choose Genesis Part 1 or Lost Colony according to installed content; Lost Colony requires its paid pack. This is a suggested play order, not the chronology of every event.

Genesis Part 1 and Part 2 are available in Survival Evolved. That doesn't justify the ASA remaster both released. Use status in Map Directory and official store; Genesis Part 2 ASA is currently not confirmed to be playable in the application's test data.
The Center, Ragnarok, Valguero and exploration maps can be played alternately. They do not replace a chapter of the main story just because there is an artifact or boss.

chapters.title: 01 · SPOILER — Earth collapses
chapters.summary: Element enables Tek technology while also becoming a threat.
paragraphs: Future civilization uses Element for extremely powerful technology. The conflict and spread of this matter left the Earth contaminated, creatures corrupted, and the Titans a huge threat.
ARK's creators were not building a dinosaur park for entertainment. They needed to preserve life through catastrophe and find a way for it to survive beyond the human era.
chapters.playGoal: Understand the cause before reading the Survivor journey.

chapters.title: 02 · SPOILER — Why do the ARKs exist?
chapters.summary: Artificial ecosystems retain life and prepare the planet for recovery.
paragraphs: ARKs are space stations carrying ecosystems, biological archives, and reconstruction technology. Their skies and day/night cycles conceal controlled environments; their creatures are not an intact snapshot of natural history.

Two approaches to saving life coexist: ARKs await a chance to reseed Earth, while Colony Ship carries humans and creatures in search of a new home. Genesis Simulation belongs to that ship; it is not another name for every ARK.
chapters.playGoal: Look at the obelisk and the sky as traces of a system.

chapters.title: 03 · SPOILER — People from many eras
chapters.summary: Archives and reconstruction technology explain Survivor's presence.
paragraphs: Helena, Mei-Yin, Nerva, and people from different eras are recreated within the system. Discovering the body chamber on Aberration forces them to ask whether they are the originals.
Implants, engrams, and regeneration are grounded in the technology of this world. However, each respawn, boss repeat, or server option should not be interpreted as a separate historical event.
chapters.playGoal: Read the notes as individual journeys, not your own diary.

chapters.title: 04 · SPOILER — The Island
chapters.summary: An island of survival leading to the truth beyond the sky.
paragraphs: Helena studies creatures; Rockwell seeks secrets; Mei-Yin fights to survive; Nerva builds New Legion and seeks control. Their different goals lead them to Obelisks and the control center.

The final conflict separates the characters onto other ARKs. For players, Broodmother, Megapithecus, and Dragon are preparation milestones; Tek Cave and Overseer unlock ascension and reveal the island as part of a larger system.
chapters.playGoal: Secure a base, collect artifacts, defeat three guardians, then face Tek Cave and Overseer.

chapters.title: 05 · SPOILER — Scorched Earth
chapters.summary: Desert survival and the tragedy of a community that wants to live in peace.
paragraphs: Raia and John Dahkeya make Nosti a refuge. The city is destroyed; John is later killed by a Wyvern. Raia loses her old faith but learns to raise the creature that caused her loss and continues helping those seeking the truth.
Helena and Rockwell travel through the desert, receive Raia's help, and continue to Aberration. The desert shows that building a civilization in ARK does not mean escaping the power of the system.
chapters.playGoal: Prepare water, Adobe, heat protection; Go to the cave and confront Manticore.

chapters.title: 06 · SPOILER — Aberration
chapters.summary: A broken ARK exposes the underlying technology and transformation of the Rockwell.
paragraphs: The survivors, including Diana and Santiago, fought the control system; the resulting damage harmed the ARK environment. Its dangerous surface pushes life into cave levels and radiation zones.

Obsessed with Element, Rockwell calls it Edmundium and experiments on himself. He becomes a monster, attacks the community, and kills Diana. Helena and Mei-Yin defeat him, but he survives and connects to the ARK system.
The reconstruction chamber and escape route turn the mystery of Survivors into evidence. Leaving Aberration takes the group to a devastated Earth.
chapters.playGoal: Learn light-pet, climbing, and Hazmat mechanics; collect artifacts and prepare for Rockwell.

chapters.title: 07 · SPOILER — Extinction
chapters.summary: Return to Earth: the goal is to facilitate the return of life.
paragraphs: Sanctuary, wasteland and experimental zones are traces of failed civilization. Santiago develops Mek; Helena gradually becomes Homo Deus and helps the Survivors carry out unfinished work from the previous group.
Defeating King Titan enables Reseed Protocol: ARKs return to restore life. This advances the plan to save Earth, but Rockwell and the fallen Aberration ARK leave a threat unresolved.
chapters.playGoal: Build resource supply chains, defend OSD/Element Vein, and prepare for the Titans and King Titan fights.

chapters.title: 08 · SPOILER — Genesis Part 1
chapters.summary: The survival test takes place in a completely digital environment.
paragraphs: HLN-A accompanies Survivor in Genesis Simulation. Many extreme biomes and missions are designed to train people for life beyond the simulation.

Rockwell infiltrates the system, corrupts its trials, and makes it serve him. Corrupted Master Controller is the digital embodiment of that control. The ending wakes the Survivor on Colony Ship, revealing danger beyond the simulation.
chapters.playGoal: Complete missions, develop biome-specific teams, and prepare for Corrupted Master Controller.

chapters.title: 09 · SPOILER — Genesis Part 2
chapters.summary: The life-saving ship becomes the final battlefield with Rockwell.
paragraphs: Colony Ship carries habitats and sleeping people toward a new world. Rockwell transforms part of it into his body and domain; HLN-A helps the Survivor oppose him.
In the final battle, HLN-A sacrifices herself and Rockwell is destroyed with the corrupted ship section. The remainder sends pods down to the new planet; a Santiago awakens, setting up ARK 2.
The Santiago here is not simply the person who died on Extinction returning to the same life. Archive and copy technology is key to understanding different versions of characters.
chapters.playGoal: In Survival Evolved: complete missions and prepare Mutagen and the Rockwell Prime fight; check ASA availability separately.

chapters.title: 10 · SPOILER — Lost Colony
chapters.summary: Arat Prime extends the consequences of Reseed and the connection to the new world.
paragraphs: Lost Colony takes you to an Earth covered in night and ice. Red Element powers the shield and city; Lost King uses it to retain control and prevent Reseed from completing here. This is a new ASA main story chapter, not a renamed Genesis Part 2.
Arat Prime connects to Colony Ship and Engram Codex, a human archive important to the future. Mei-Yin and Diana return; Aberration and Rockwell connections clarify missing links.

The campaign includes flashbacks and events later than Extinction. Community sources describe a gap of over a millennium; this guide gives no absolute figure and does not place all Lost Colony before Genesis. Learn the Genesis ending first to understand the full significance.
chapters.playGoal: Follow the campaign, find notes, prepare against the cold and head to the Red Palace.

chapters.title: 11 · Discovery map is not a required chapter
chapters.summary: A map with a boss can still serve its own sandbox experience.
paragraphs: The Center, Ragnarok, Valguero, Crystal Isles, Lost Island, and Fjordur expand exploration, taming, and building. Ruins, runes, arenas, or mythological themes do not establish a canon chapter continuing Helena's story.

Astraeos and separate-content maps such as Atlantis and Dragontopia have their own themes and progression. Distinguish map-author lore from the main ARK story; inclusion in this app's catalog does not mean every map has released on ASA.
chapters.playGoal: Choose by biome, creature and base target; no need to force lore order.

chapters.title: 12 · Sequel and limitation information
chapters.summary: Finishing a game is not proof that a sequel has come out.
paragraphs: ARK 2 continues the journey of life toward planet Arat after Genesis Part 2. Do not infer a finished story or playable content.

Animated Series is an adaptation with different characters and events; Bob’s Tall Tales/True Tales adds perspective or gameplay. This guide prioritizes notes and endings in the game, avoiding merging all versions into a single history.
chapters.playGoal: Follow the official catalog and source before purchasing or transferring saves.

characters.title: Helena Walker
paragraphs: The biologist anchors our understanding of creatures and ARK's secrets. She writes dossiers, learns to fight, and chooses to help others rather than seek power.
SPOILER: becoming Homo Deus lets her intervene in the system and prepare the Survivor against King Titan. Her power does not remove her limitations or their cost.

characters.title: Mei-Yin Li
paragraphs: A warrior from ancient China, known for her combat skill and bond with creatures. She opposes Nerva, stands beside Helena, and develops a deep relationship with Diana.
SPOILER: interpret her return in Lost Colony through the new campaign, rather than only her original “Beast Queen” image.

characters.title: Edmund Rockwell
paragraphs: Once a researcher and useful ally, Rockwell increasingly treats knowledge as his privilege. His Element obsession turns curiosity into a desire to dominate.
SPOILER: experimenting on himself turns Rockwell into a monster in Aberration; Genesis expands him from a threat to one ARK into the controller of the simulation and Colony Ship.

characters.title: Diana Altaras
paragraphs: A pilot familiar with future technology, Diana bridges the survivors and Tek. Her relationship with Mei-Yin provides a human story amid catastrophe.
SPOILER: Rockwell kills her on Aberration; Helena helps her return. Therefore, seeing Diana in later chapters should not be interpreted as meaning that the previous notes were wrong.

characters.title: Santiago
paragraphs: An engineer and hacker who turns system knowledge into survival strategies. His Tek and Mek work is foundational in Aberration and Extinction.

SPOILER: the version Santiago during the ARK voyage and the version awakened on the Colony Ship must be distinguished. Repositories can create multiple versions; The same name does not guarantee the same memories and life.

characters.title: HLN-A
paragraphs: Created by Helena, this assistant has memories and personality connected to her creator while remaining a distinct character. In Genesis, she explains environments and missions and speaks directly with the Survivor.
SPOILER: the sacrifice in Genesis Part 2 clarifies the purpose of protecting humanity's future, as opposed to Rockwell wanting everyone to obey.

characters.title: Raia & John Dahkeya
paragraphs: Raia brings organization and care to Nosti; John protects the community and teaches her self-defense. Their notes turn the desert into a story of building, love, and loss.
SPOILER: losing John causes Raia to change but not give up. Raising Wyvern is both a survival skill and a sign she learns to live on after tragedy.

characters.title: Gaius Marcellus Nerva
paragraphs: A Roman general who sees The Island as a place to conquer. New Legion and his pursuit of Obelisk power draw the other characters into conflict.
SPOILER: Mei-Yin defeats him. Nerva 's actions unintentionally paved the way for the group to leave the Island, even though his goal was to dominate.

characters.title: Lost King
paragraphs: SPOILER: Lost Colony's ruler uses Red Element and his power structure to keep the city alive in an unhealed world. He directly opposes Reseed.
Read his motives and relationships through the Lost Colony campaign and notes; vampire/gothic styling does not make this merely a fantasy map outside the lore.
